findings: Public standard SDK network.get is deliberately finite GET with global proxy and optional official GitHub headers; it cannot POST or attach arbitrary site Cookie. sites.read emits safe site handles with no raw credential.

Ordinary subprocess Go plugins retain normal Go net/http networking: protocol.go launches a native exec.CommandContext, without a network namespace/chroot/seccomp or Python dependency. A plugin can send GET/POST using its own configuration credentials; this is a native language capability, not a missing host RPC.

Existing autosignin BoundSiteHTTP supports RequestPlan.Method POST, cookie/referer/body/JSON/proxy/redirect guard semantics. BindRegistrationHooks receives a trusted host-only Registration with current site credential snapshot. It is a business adapter, not exposed to an arbitrary standard SDK worker, and not counted as currently wired platform POST.

Accordingly no existing standard SDK operation presently performs arbitrary POST with host site credentials for an AutoSignIn worker. It must not be claimed available through network.get. Wiring those paused business adapters or adding an authenticated generic request capability requires a separately justified source/callsite scope decision; this review adds neither.

The sealed77-file installed AST lists the original AutoSignIn POST callsites, while normalized historical source strings are not byte-identical original files and were not treated as raw original SHA proof. No centralCookie symbol is present in current repository source/that normalized AutoSignIn capture; if coordinator means another specific caller, the exact source position is still needed.

scope_decision.decision: Add S18 configured-site ordinary authenticated HTTP to the unique matrix; this is a platform host-capability gap, not paused AutoSignIn business migration. Existing Go IO or host-only historical business adapters do not close it.
current_gap: Sites.Read only projects identity/network flags; it returns no Cookie/UA/apikey/token values.
Sites.Browse invokes specific search behavior; RSS/Torrent use specific resource-material helpers; neither accepts an ordinary arbitrary POST.
minimum_shared_contract: Site-handle ordinary request with GET/POST, form including repeated values, JSON/raw body, ordinary headers/referer/UA; host keeps configured credential and proxy material.
RequestUtils-derived status/body/None/error/redirect/cookie/content decoding/socket timeout semantics; non2xx response distinct from network failure and no unsafe automatic POST retries.

Current site config/identity and plugin execution scope validated before dispatch/each redirect; origin credential protections are recorded as necessary adaptations instead of falsely claiming source permits only same-origin.

specific_business_callsite_examples.MTeam: Raw Authorization=site.token, sha256(token)-derived Did/visitorid; destination api.<domain> may differ from configured frontend origin. This source fact must not be confused with x-api-key authentication.
specific_business_callsite_examples.RousiPro: api-token=site.apikey first, then normalized Bearer(site.token) fallback; JSON body with explicit application/json header.
specific_business_callsite_examples.HDChina: Initial filtered hdchina Cookie, then response.cookies.get_dict replaces cookies on following POST; source has no permanent shared Session by default.
specific_business_callsite_examples.boundary: Do not implement these business retry, endpoint, signature or site-parser algorithms in the platform migration. Declare the shared credential/network adaptation precisely; lack of arbitrary host-cookie POST was the platform gap.
